steps: Create and capture a test payment with sufficient refundable balance.
Set RAZORPAY_KEY_ID, RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET, and RAZORPAY_TEST_PAYMENT_ID in the local environment.
Set a test-mode webhook URL and RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET.
Run the legitimate-rescue workflow and retain the sanitized refund id and audit export.
razorpay_test_closure.success_condition: Razorpay test API returns a refund id and the webhook signature is validated.
